headline: EU Approves Final €12.7 Billion Recovery Fund Tranche for Poland
summary: The European Commission gave final approval for a €12.7 billion ($54 billion PLN) payout to Poland under the EU post-pandemic recovery plan.
why: EU funding transfers enhance public investment, support balance of payments stability, and boost GDP growth in Poland.

impacts.name: Poland
impacts.why: Poland secures a €12.7 billion disbursement from the European Commission.
